info.name: Yareta Research Data Access OAI-PMH API

description.content:
Yareta is the University of Geneva (UNIGE) e-Research long-term research-data preservation and access platform, built on the DLCM (Data Life Cycle Management) software stack. This OpenAPI description merges the public DLCM/Yareta backend modules: the Accession/Access service (https://access.yareta.unige.ch) for discovering, ordering and downloading archives (AIP/DIP), and the Ingestion/Pre-ingest service (https://ingest.yareta.unige.ch) for depositing and submitting research data. Faithfully converted from the live OpenAPI 3.1 definitions (Yareta API v3.1.7); only real paths and schemas are retained.

Contact Support:
 Email: yareta-admin@unige.ch
